findings.title: Delete menu item is never shown in the list view
findings.body: The Delete item is gated on `canDelete && rulerRule`. The list view (GrafanaRuleListItem) no longer passes `rulerRule`, so Delete is hidden even for users with delete permission, which the new `grafanaDeleteAbility` check was meant to allow. The same gating hides Pause (line 123, `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` and `MenuItemPauseRule` requires `rulerRule`). The updated GrafanaGroupLoader test asserts exactly 4 menu items, which locks in the missing Delete action instead of catching it.

findings.title: Silence menu item in the list view does nothing when clicked
findings.body: `canSilence` is now true from the promRule-based ability, so the Silence item is shown in the list view. Its handler `handleSilence` only sets `showSilenceDrawer` in RuleActionsButtons. The drawer is rendered only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` holds, and in the list view `rule` (the ruler rule) is undefined, so clicking Silence silently does nothing.

findings.title: Missing React key on GrafanaRuleListItem in the filter view
findings.body: The `grafana` case returns `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` inside `rules.map` without a `key` prop. The previous `GrafanaRuleLoader` had `key={key}`, and the datasource branch still has it. React will warn about missing keys and may mis-reconcile list items when the filtered list changes.

findings.title: Federated rule group immutability check was dropped
findings.body: `useAllRulerRuleAbilities` now hardcodes `isFederated = false`. The previous `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` used `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`, which made federated groups non-editable/non-deletable/non-duplicable. Since `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` now delegates to this hook, federated rules that used to be locked will now show Edit/Delete/Pause as allowed, which is a permission regression. The TODO does not restore the old behaviour.

findings.title: Rule view link drops the returnTo parameter
findings.body: The removed GrafanaRuleLoader built the href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo })` using `createReturnTo()`. The new `GrafanaRuleListItem` builds `/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view` without `returnTo`, so the rule view page loses the ability to navigate back to the list with its filters.

findings.title: Test asserts the regression instead of the intended behaviour
findings.body: The GrafanaGroupLoader test 'should render correct menu actions' expects exactly 4 menu items (silence, copy link, duplicate, export) and omits Delete. Because it encodes the current missing-Delete behaviour, it will not flag the regression. No test covers clicking Silence or Delete from the list view.
